formulas.centroid: mean(x), mean(y) over valid players on that team at the timestamp
formulas.compactness: mean Euclidean distance of players from the team centroid

axis_note: StatsBomb frame: x in [0, 120] along pitch length, y in [0, 80] along pitch width. This module follows the requested formulas (width on x, length on y).
identity_note: Team labels come from kit-color clustering on filtered tracks. Track IDs are not persistent player identities; counts are not guaranteed to be 11.
